data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after you roll one of these for a unit or model of yours: a [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls), [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls), [Save](vsdata:core-rule/save-rolls), Damage, [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), [Charge](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) or [Hazard](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls) roll, or the roll for how many attacks a weapon makes.

**Target:** That unit or model.

**Effect:** You re-roll the roll. If it used more than one die, pick one of them to re-roll, except for a Charge roll, where every die is re-rolled.
